# Review of PELModuliPartII (pull request #2453 at d9b6dfa)

**Verdict:** needs changes

## R01 (P3) — §6.7's list of product-datum lattices omits §7.6

**Location:** `TauCetiRoadmap/PELModuliPartII/README.md:1381` (§6.7): "A lattice Λ₀⊕Λ of a product datum (§§7.7, 8.1, 8.4), Λ a lattice of the Hom-Tate space, means Λ₀,v⊕Λ·b". §7.6 (line 1553): "generated by the single self-dual lattice Λ₀⊕Λ".

**Claim:** §7.6 writes Λ₀⊕Λ twice, in its statement and in its route. It is missing from the list, and its *Needs:* line does not name §6.7. Its claim that Λ₀⊕Λ is self-dual is true only in the §6.7 sense.

**Witness:** In the setting of §6.7's last Check (c=pδ), take Λ self-dual and read it as a hermitian-self-dual lattice of W. Its alternating dual is then c·𝔇⁻¹·Λ=pΛ≠Λ. In the §6.7 sense the dual is Λ₀⊕Λ^♯·b=Λ₀⊕Λ·b.

**Repair:** In §6.7, replace "(§§7.7, 8.1, 8.4)" with "(§§7.6, 7.7, 8.1, 8.4)". In §7.6, replace "generated by the single self-dual lattice Λ₀⊕Λ" with "generated by the single self-dual lattice Λ₀⊕Λ in the sense of §6.7", and add "§6.7" to §7.6's *Needs:* line.

## Source issues

- **Misprint** in RSZ21 at Remark 6.5, (6.4)–(6.5), pp. 30–31: the source says the hermitian dual of the Hom lattice is π_v^m·Hom(Λ₀,Λ^∨) when Λ₀^∨=π_v^mΛ₀; it should be π_v^(−m)·Hom(Λ₀,Λ^∨), since Hom(π^mΛ₀,Λ^∨)=π^(−m)Hom(Λ₀,Λ^∨); affects nothing.
